name: Incident Postmortem
description: Assembling a blameless postmortem grounded in systems of record: timeline reconstruction merging the incident tool's event log with correlated observability anomalies (Sentry error spikes, Datadog/Grafana metric anomalies, including precursor signal that predates formal detection) and deploy history from connected platform connectors, all normalized to one stated timezone; the root-cause versus contributing-factor distinction and the test for telling them apart; and how to label a root cause that is still only a hypothesis.
